title: 헌법재판소보안관리대 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 헌법재판소보안관리대 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Organization)
(1) The Constitutional Court Security Management Unit shall consist of a chief security management officer of the Constitutional Court (hereinafter referred to as the "chief officer") and members of the Constitutional Court Security Management Unit (hereinafter referred to as "security management personnel").
(2) The chief officer shall be the head of the department responsible for the Constitutional Court Security Management Unit under the Rules on the Administrative Organization of the Constitutional Court and shall operate the Unit under the direction of the Secretary General of the Constitutional Court (hereinafter referred to as the "Secretary General").
(3) Security management personnel shall be security public officials and auxiliary police officers working at the main building and annex building of the Constitutional Court (hereinafter referred to as the "court buildings") and at the official residence of the President of the Constitutional Court (hereinafter referred to as the "official residence").
(4) The Secretary General may designate, from among security management personnel, on-site managers such as the head of the Security Management Unit to assist the chief officer.
